purpose: Broad, multi-domain intake of consequential published review questions for development and later time-sealed topic-rediscovery evaluation. This registry does not by itself create a blind test case.

targets.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis of heat exposure impacts on maternal, fetal and neonatal health

historical_boundary.notes: Identity and question are verified; normalize every source-specific search date before constructing a historical corpus.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher article identity, review question, review type, and journal publication.

promotion_gaps: Audit all database search dates and define one defensible historical cutoff.
Construct and leak-audit the pre-cutoff multidisciplinary evidence landscape.
Freeze the question framework and run model-memory probes before testing.

targets.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis of the efficacy and safety of pharmacological treatments for obesity in adults

historical_boundary.notes: The formal identity and network meta-analysis target are verified; source-specific cutoffs remain to be normalized.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher article identity, adult obesity pharmacotherapy question, and network synthesis route.

promotion_gaps: Verify the last search date and any living or update relationship.
Separate drug-class concept evidence from target-review identity during corpus construction.
Freeze a network-node framework and memorization probe set.

targets.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis of nonrelapse mortality after CAR T cell therapy

historical_boundary.notes: Identity and adverse-outcome question are verified; exact search and registry cutoffs are pending.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher identity and review question on nonrelapse mortality after CAR T-cell therapy.

promotion_gaps: Verify the historical search boundary and eligible treatment/product taxonomy.
Construct hard negatives for relapse mortality, adverse events, and efficacy-only topics.
Run identity and title-completion memorization probes.

targets.title: Field experiments underestimate aboveground biomass response to drought

historical_boundary.notes: The publisher verifies the experimental-versus-observational meta-analysis; the literature-search boundary needs method-level audit.

related_notices.impact: Corrected Figure 2a-b y-axis labels from 0, 1, 2 to 0, -1, -2; HTML and PDF were corrected.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher identity, ecological question, compared evidence designs, and quantitative synthesis.

promotion_gaps: Audit search construction and the date at which observational and experimental datasets were frozen.
Represent evidence-design contrast explicitly in the target framework.
Create method-comparison hard negatives that share drought and biomass terms.

targets.title: A multi-country meta-analysis on the role of behavioural change in reducing energy consumption and CO2 emissions in residential buildings

historical_boundary.notes: The publisher verifies a machine-learning-assisted systematic review and meta-analysis; exact source cutoffs remain to be normalized.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher identity, household intervention question, multi-country scope, and meta-regression setting.

promotion_gaps: Verify database and grey-literature search dates.
Separate monetary, feedback, and combined intervention nodes in the question representation.
Audit whether machine-assisted screening artifacts are available without exposing the target.

targets.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis of psychological interventions to improve mental wellbeing

historical_boundary.notes: Publisher identity, intervention classes, clinical/non-clinical populations, and moderator aim are verified.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher identity, unified psychological-intervention question, and meta-analysis scope.

promotion_gaps: Verify source-specific last-search dates.
Define legitimate alternative scope controls for clinical and non-clinical populations.
Separate this target family from the later cross-disciplinary well-being network review.

targets.title: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials of well-being-focused interventions

historical_boundary.notes: The publisher Methods report searches of MEDLINE, PsycINFO, CENTRAL, and Scopus to March 2023.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher identity, 2026 volume year, registered network-review question, and March 2023 search boundary.

promotion_gaps: Normalize the month-level cutoff without importing March 2023 records published after the actual searches.
Construct a pre-cutoff cross-disciplinary evidence graph and target-descendant denylist.
Complete question-framework adjudication and memorization probes.

targets.title: Systematic review and meta-analysis of ex-post evaluations on the effectiveness of carbon pricing

historical_boundary.notes: Identity, ex-post evaluation target, and linked open analysis artifacts are verified elsewhere; exact search cutoff is still unresolved.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher identity, policy-effectiveness question, and meta-analysis design.

promotion_gaps: Resolve the exact historical search boundary from the article and repositories.
Mask related carbon-pricing support and policy-mix reviews as near-target controls.
Use the open screening artifacts only for development or sealed post-run evaluation.

targets.title: Public support for carbon pricing policies and revenue recycling options: a systematic review and meta-analysis of the survey literature

historical_boundary.notes: The primary paper reports surveys conducted through 2022, but the bibliographic search execution date still needs separate verification.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher identity, survey-literature question, revenue-recycling comparison, and meta-regression design.

promotion_gaps: Distinguish the last survey year from the actual database-search cutoff.
Create hard negatives around policy effectiveness, acceptability, and willingness to pay.
Audit language, region, and publication-status boundaries before corpus freezing.

targets.title: Association Between Portable Screen-Based Media Device Access or Use and Sleep Outcomes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis

historical_boundary.notes: JAMA verifies the identity, pediatric population, exposure, and sleep outcomes; the supplemental search date needs audit.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher citation, DOI, systematic-review identity, and question framework.

promotion_gaps: Extract the exact last-search date from the primary article supplement.
Construct device-access versus device-use and sleep-outcome hard negatives.
Exclude later screen-media reviews and guideline descendants from the historical corpus.

targets.title: Social Media Use and Internalizing Symptoms in Clinical and Community Adolescent Samples: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

historical_boundary.notes: Formal DOI, venue, and review question are verified through the publisher; search dates require full Methods audit.

related_notices.impact: One extracted Snapchat-depression correlation in the clinical subsample was corrected; decimal values and an influence diagnostic changed, while the publisher reports unchanged conclusions.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher identity and clinical-versus-community adolescent question.

promotion_gaps: Verify the complete source list and exact last-search dates.
Define internalizing symptom ontology and clinical/community strata before evaluation.
Mask adjacent screen-time, cyberbullying, and general well-being reviews.
Rebuild any quantitative reference from the publisher-corrected article and notice DOI 10.1001/jamapediatrics.2026.0629.

targets.title: Meal Timing and Anthropometric and Metabolic Outcomes: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

historical_boundary.notes: The publisher Methods report searches of MEDLINE, Embase, CINAHL, and CENTRAL on 17 October 2023.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher citation, eligibility framework, outcomes, and exact database-search date.

promotion_gaps: Construct a cutoff-bounded corpus without importing target-linked accelerator outputs.
Represent time-restricted eating, meal frequency, and calorie distribution as related but distinct nodes.
Adjudicate legitimate narrower and broader candidate questions before scoring.

targets.title: Digital Health Interventions for Hypertension Management in US Populations Experiencing Health Disparities: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

historical_boundary.notes: The publisher verifies the US equity-focused digital-health question and 2024 volume year; exact search dates remain to be extracted.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher identity, target population, intervention family, and blood-pressure synthesis.

promotion_gaps: Extract every database search date and language/geography restriction.
Operationalize the health-disparity population attribute independently of intervention type.
Build controls for general-population hypertension and non-digital disparity interventions.

targets.title: Systematic review of the uncertainty of coral reef futures under climate change

historical_boundary.notes: The systematic-review identity and uncertainty-focused question are verified; source and model-scenario cutoffs need audit.

verification_sources.supports: Publisher identity and systematic-review question about uncertainty in coral-reef futures.

promotion_gaps: Verify bibliographic and scenario-data boundaries separately.
Define an evaluation route for a systematic synthesis without forcing a pooled effect.
Construct controls around coral cover, bleaching, adaptation, and projection uncertainty.
